sections.label: Killmail queries
sections.description: Build a filtered path to retrieve ESI-format killmails with zKillboard metadata.

endpoints.description: Modifiers are path segments, can be combined in any order, and return up to 200 killmails. Results are newest first and include the ESI killmail plus a zkb metadata object.

parameters.name: kills, losses
parameters.description: Match an entity as an attacker or victim. Omit both to include either side.

parameters.name: characterID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by character.

parameters.name: corporationID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by corporation.

parameters.name: allianceID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by alliance.

parameters.name: factionID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by faction.

parameters.name: shipTypeID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by victim or attacker ship type.

parameters.name: groupID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by inventory group.

parameters.name: solarSystemID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by solar system. systemID is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: constellationID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by constellation.

parameters.name: regionID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by region.

parameters.name: locationID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by a resolved location.

parameters.name: warID/{id}
parameters.description: Filter by war.

parameters.name: killID/{id}
parameters.description: Fetch one killmail by ID.

parameters.name: highsec, lowsec, nullsec, w-space, abyssal
parameters.description: Filter by security band or special space.

parameters.name: solo, ganked
parameters.description: Return only solo PvP or highsec ganks.

parameters.name: awox/{0|1}, npc/{0|1}
parameters.description: Include or exclude awox and NPC killmails.

parameters.name: label/{label}
parameters.description: Filter on a raw zKillboard label, such as capital or loc:pochven.

parameters.name: finalblow-only
parameters.description: Require the selected entity to have the final blow. Place an entity filter first.

parameters.name: iskValue/{value}
parameters.description: Minimum total value in ISK. The value must be a positive multiple of 500,000,000.

parameters.name: pastSeconds/{seconds}
parameters.description: Look back up to 604,800 seconds in one-hour increments. Place an entity filter first.

parameters.name: year/{YYYY}/month/{M}
parameters.description: Select a calendar month. Month is 1–12 without a leading zero. Place an entity filter first.

parameters.name: page/{page}
parameters.description: Page 1–100, with up to 200 results per page. Place an entity filter first.

parameters.name: pretty
parameters.description: Pretty-print the JSON response.

examples.label: Hole Lotta Trouble losses in wormhole space
A week of Squizz Caphinator solo kills

    "victim": { "...": "ESI victim and items" },
    "attackers": [{ "...": "ESI attacker" }],
    "zkb": {
      "hash": "...",
      "totalValue": 123456789.01,

      "npc": false,

      "labels": ["solo", "loc:highsec"]
    }

notes: Do not use query strings on this endpoint; filters belong in the path.
Killmails less than five minutes old are withheld from this API.
The legacy zkbOnly, no-attackers, no-items, asc, desc, json, xml, limit, orderDirection, startTime/endTime, beforeKillID/afterKillID, and comma-separated Entity ID modifiers are disabled.
Responses include a wildcard CORS header for browser-based clients.

sections.label: Statistics & prices

sections.label: Posting killmails
sections.description: Submit an ESI killmail immediately or queue it for delayed publication.

endpoints.description: Validates the ID and 40-character ESI hash, fetches the killmail, and returns a machine-readable result. Delayed requests return as soon as they are queued.

parameters.name: killID
parameters.description: Killmail ID from ESI.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The 40-character ESI killmail hash.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: 0 ASAP, 1 one hour, 2 three hours, 3 eight hours, 4 one day, or 5 three days. Invalid values become 0.

notes: HTTP 401 means the poster exceeded the invalid-post trust limit; 408 means immediate processing timed out; 422 means the request or ESI result was invalid.

endpoints.summary: Submit a killmail as a form
endpoints.description: The browser-oriented alternative. Send an ESI killmail URL as form data; the response is HTML or a redirect to the killmail.

parameters.name: killmailurl
parameters.description: A URL in the form https://esi.evetech.net/killmails/{killID}/{hash}/.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Uses the same 0–5 delay scale as the JSON endpoint.

sections.label: Live feed & archives
sections.description: Iterate new killmails through R2Z2 or download complete daily history files.

endpoints.description: Returns a recent monotonic sequence ID. Fetch that numbered JSON file, increment the sequence, and continue until a 404.
notes: The pointer updates every 51 killmails. Sequence IDs are global, strictly increasing, and monotonic. A reprocessed killmail may appear again under a new sequence ID.

endpoints.description: Returns the raw ESI killmail, zKillboard metadata, upload time, sequence ID, and an optional sequence_updated marker.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: The sequence to fetch. Increment by one after each successful response.

notes: Files remain available for at least 24 hours. Filter locally after retrieval.
After a 404, wait at least six seconds before trying again. The service allows up to 15 requests per second per IP and requires a non-empty User-Agent.

endpoints.description: Returns every known killmail ID and hash for a UTC date. Use this compact index when rebuilding an archive.

parameters.name: YYYYMMDD
parameters.description: UTC calendar date, such as 20160816.

endpoints.description: Downloads the full raw killmail data known to zKillboard for one UTC date.
Returns the number of archived killmails for each date so clients can identify missing or changed daily files.
